technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic bounce signal, but price remains below key moving averages with negative momentum indicators and weak trend structure—recovery setup only, not a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: PM shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 35 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed/neutral with no conviction signal, and absent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (406.4), flat yield curve with recession signals, and post-FOMC volatility create severely unfavourable macro conditions; 35-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 & 14) with stochastic bullish cross and contrarian fear-zone opportunity present classic bounce setup near support at 80.75.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages with negative momentum (MACD, AO, OBV, CMF), zero fundamental support, crisis-level VIX regime, and earnings event risk in 35 days make this a recovery trap, not a swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold with stochastic bullish cross presents technical bounce setup; contrarian fear-zone opportunity aligns with VIX crisis regime.
decision.primary_risk: Price remains trapped below all key moving averages with negative momentum confirmation (MACD, AO, OBV, CMF); earnings event in 35 days creates binary event risk in unfavourable macro environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 6 positions in Consumer Staples sector; adding PM increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart money support to justify sector overweight.
